title: East Nash 4bd w/ Rooftop! Parking! 10 min to DT!
description:
Great for large groups, families traveling together + teams!

Walking distance to many restaurants, bars, venues + shops in East! Short 1.1 miles to Nissan Stadium + a short ride to downtown Broadway! Perfect for large groups and couples!

The space
The artwork in the unit is all local artists!
We love to support our friends and community.

✔️The first floor has two queen bedrooms and one bath.
✔️Take the flight of stairs up to the main quarters and you’ll find a fully equipped chefs kitchen, a six person designer wood table to dine, and an expansive living area.
✔️Take the next flight of stairs up to the third-floor where you will find a queen bedroom with a bathroom, a king master with an en suite bathroom.
✔️Take some selfie‘s or group photos in front of our Nashville selfie wall!
✔️Enjoy the rooftop feels and views as you make your way to the fourth floor. Here you can enjoy a game of cod hole or ring toss!
